sentences.en: Prof. Smith is famous for his eccentric life style.
sentences.zh: 史密斯教授以其古怪的生活方式而闻名。

sentences.en: He's an eccentric man who thought that time was not linear.
sentences.zh: 他是个思想怪异的人，认为时间不是线性的。

sentences.en: Be eccentric now. Don't wait for old age to wear purple.
sentences.zh: 现在就要做自己，别等到老了再穿紫色衣服。

senses.zh: 行为出格的，不循规蹈矩的：deviating conventional
